ambiguity.detail: The cold open flashes forward to a moment of retribution we haven't reached yet.

verdict.hook_line: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: After being publicly dumped and insulted at her wedding, a humiliated bride vows silent vengeance against her ex and her family.
verdict.why_it_works: The flash-forward hook creates instant narrative tension, and the build-up of insults sets up a deeply satisfying revenge arc.
